An '''outpost''' with a [[spaceport]] was located on the plains of [[Dantooine]]. Many [[Resistance]] recruits were escorted off planet from the outpost by [[Jade Squadron]] and [[Ace Squadron]] when the [[First Order]] came to [[Blockade of Dantooine|occupy]] the planet<ref name="Rebuilding" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|2|17}}</ref>
